text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! The perfect drink after a perfect
patrol!
Excellent choice, me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Nothing beats a sports drink after
sweating
a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You know, I didn't know your Bakushin
Patrols
were so long! You just kept
going and going! It
was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For my patrol to truly protect the
student body, it
must last twenty-four
seven, three hundred
sixty-five days a
year!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why me, you might ask? Because it is my
duty as
a genius to protect the peace!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... you're the school's
hero?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Class representative by day, school hero
by
night... The Masked Representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I LIKE IT! The perfect title for one such
as I!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am the Masked
Representative—Bakushin Red!
And in
order to eradicate evil... I shall do
another
patrol! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa! Lemme help, Bakushin Red!
Special
Move: Super Patrol Daaash!
